blocks.content:
Act: 1964
Established: 1965
Type: Statutory Corporation
HQ: New Delhi
Functions: Procurement, Storage, Distribution
Linked With: MSP, PDS, NFSA

items: Questions frequently distinguish between the Act year (1964) and the Establishment year (1965).
Always remember the organizational structure is a Statutory Corporation based in New Delhi.
Note the direct connection to major schemes: MSP (Minimum Support Price), PDS (Public Distribution System), and NFSA (National Food Security Act).

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: The body was constituted as a Statutory Corporation under the Act of 1964.
It was officially established in 1965 with headquarters in New Delhi.
Core operational functions include Procurement, Storage, and Distribution.
It plays a pivotal role linked with MSP, PDS, and NFSA.
